title: Stakeholder press kit: quarterly strategy synthesis & action gates
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: Produce a concise, stakeholder-ready "press kit" for the upcoming quarterly strategy readout. The kit bundles a 10-slide executive deck, 1-page summary, data appendix (latency/cost/usage trends), prioritized action gates with owners, and a risk & mitigation heatmap. Audience includes CEO, CRO, CTO, Head of Engineering, and two board members. The goal is to create a single artifact that enables the execs to: (a) understand the state of product/serving economics across Hosted/Dedicated/Private, (b) approve proposed investment gates and tradeoffs for Q2, and (c) have clear, measurable success criteria for the next quarter. Deliverables: 1) 10-slide deck (strategy synthesis + top 3 asks), 2) 1-page one-pager for board packet, 3) data appendix (performance trends, cost per 1k tokens, Dedicated utilization), 4) Decision table with owners & deadlines, 5) Risk heatmap and fallbacks, 6) Appendix of supporting artifacts (benchmarks, customer quotes, PRs). Key tradeoffs to highlight: runtime perf vs unit cost (batching/quantization), Dedicated capacity commitments vs burst ingress, and Private deployment lift vs compliance revenue upside. Use the Console dashboards and runtime telemetry as primary data sources; include representative customer anecdotes (anonymized) where it strengthens the ask.
acceptance_criteria: Executive deck (<=10 slides) reviewed and approved by PM, Eng leadership, and Design
One-pager finalized and formatted for board packet
Metrics appendix contains P50/P95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, Dedicated pool utilization for last 3 months
Decision table lists owners, requested approvals, and clear success metrics
Dry run with CEO/CTO scheduled and feedback addressed at least 24 hours before delivery
outcome_metrics: Approve two investment gates: Dedicated capacity expansion and Console observability retention (yes/no)
Target: reduce P95 latency by 15% within 60 days for top-5 customer routes
Target: reduce unit inference cost by 10% via batching/quantization recommendations accepted into roadmap
Commitment: secure at least 2 pilot customers for Private deployment in Q2

Use Dedicated capacity expansion as a time-limited commit: 6-month pilot with auto-escalation clauses rather than an open long-term commit.

Risk: Board wants immediate revenue targets. Mitigation: provide phased success metrics (pilot conversion -> contract close) with realistic timelines.
